name: Full Smile
verdict: The biggest movement this period is a 94.74% drop in leads over the last 7 days, likely driven by at least one zero-spend day flagged in the account, which would have cut Meta delivery and caused the CPL to spike 1,272.33%. Top campaign "BWS - Instant Leads - Awareness" led spend at $355.36, but the 28d total of 77 leads (Meta/Windsor) vs. 79 opportunities (GHL) are unreconciled.

performance.verdict: Spend halted Sep 12–13 and Sep 16; leads dead 6 days straight — confirm before declaring trend.

findings.text: Zero-spend days Sep 12, 13, and 16 caused leads to flatline: 0 leads across all 6 days Sep 11–16, CPL spiked 1,272% vs prior 7d.
3-day signal (Sep 14–16) vs prior 3 (Sep 11–13): spend $57.43 vs $32 but leads still 0 — delivery is not recovering even on spend-active days.

3 overdue SOW milestones — phone-match attribution (Aug 7), sync/contact cleanup (Aug 14), and dashboard + renewal scoreboard (Aug 31) — all undelivered; client's stay/walk decision was tied to Aug 31 dashboard.
GBP actions dropped 63% in last 7d and show 0 for Sep 13–16; GBP had been averaging ~10 actions/day — organic dark alongside paid dark compounds the visibility loss.
GHL shows 79 opportunities vs 77 Meta leads in 28d, but 0 appointments and 0 won — the intake funnel is receiving leads but converting none to chair, indicating an intake/CRM process leak.

suggestions.text: Diagnose and restore Meta campaign delivery — zero spend on Sep 12, 13, 16 must be explained before any budget decision.
suggestions.monday_update: Meta spend hit $0 on Sep 12, 13, and 16, causing 0 leads across 6 consecutive days and a 1,272% CPL spike. Check campaign status, payment method, budget exhaustion, and policy flags in Ads Manager today. Success is confirmed when daily spend resumes at the ~$25–38 normal range and leads return within 3 days. Re-check Sep 20.

suggestions.text: Escalate GHL intake leak: 79 opps created, 0 appointments booked — review pipeline stage logic and new intake hire process.
suggestions.monday_update: GHL shows 79 opportunities created in 28 days but 0 appointments and 0 won deals — leads are entering the CRM but nothing is being scheduled. Review pipeline stage transitions, automated follow-up triggers, and the new intake hire's workflow with Lily. This is not an ads problem; it is an intake/CRM process gap. Success is at least 5 appointments logged within 7 days of this fix. Re-check Sep 24.

suggestions.text: Watch Sep 14–16 spend recovery ($57.43 total) — if leads remain 0 by Sep 20, creative or account-level issue is confirmed.
suggestions.monday_update: Spend on Sep 14–16 totalled $57.43 but generated 0 leads, suggesting the zero-spend days may have reset delivery learning or triggered a policy hold. GBP is also dark for the same window, removing organic support. If leads remain at 0 by Sep 20 despite restored spend, escalate to creative refresh and account audit. Re-check Sep 20.
